anomalies.description: A severely crumpled passenger car is stationary on the highway shoulder, with a white semi-truck and a green truck stopped nearby; debris is visible on the road surface.

verification.reason: The vehicle is extensively deformed in a manner consistent with a high-impact crash; no motion of the wrecked car across frames indicates it is post-collision; surrounding trucks are stationary, suggesting an accident scene. This matches the definition of CarAccident (a crash).

anomalies.description: A silver sedan collides with another vehicle (likely a dark SUV or truck) in the oncoming lane around t=12.0–13.0, spins across the road, and comes to rest heavily damaged on the right shoulder by t=14.0, remaining stationary thereafter.

verification.reason: Frames f3–f6 show the collision and spin; f7–f21 show the damaged car stationary on the shoulder with visible deformation, smoke/dust, and debris—consistent with a single crash event. All three candidates describe overlapping phases of the same accident; merged into one continuous event from first impact to final rest state.

anomalies.description: A vehicle on the right shoulder emits a plume of white smoke or vapor and appears to be stationary or slowing abruptly, while other traffic continues normally.

verification.reason: In f4 (90.5s), a sudden puff of white smoke/vapor appears near the right roadside; by f5–f7 (91.0–92.0s), the source vehicle remains in place with visible disturbance (likely tire smoke or coolant steam) consistent with a crash or mechanical failure; no other vehicles are seen colliding, but the stationary distressed vehicle with emission satisfies CarAccident definition (crash or disabling incident involving a vehicle).
